extra_vocab.en: an official check of a company's records to make sure they are correct
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，annual audit 指公司每年一次的稽核，會計團隊要保留已簽署合約的副本，供稽核人員檢查。audit 也可以當動詞，意思是「稽核、查帳」。

example.en: All departments must prepare their records for the annual audit.
example.zh: 所有部門都必須為年度稽核準備好紀錄。

example.en: An outside firm will conduct an audit of our accounts.
example.zh: 一家外部公司將對我們的帳目進行稽核。

example.en: The internal audit found several errors in the expense reports.
example.zh: 內部稽核發現費用報告中有幾處錯誤。

example.en: The factory passed the audit without any major problems.
example.zh: 這家工廠順利通過稽核，沒有重大問題。

examples.en: The finance team is getting ready for next month's audit.
examples.zh: 財務團隊正在為下個月的稽核做準備。

examples.en: Please send me the signed contracts before the audit begins.
examples.zh: 請在稽核開始前把已簽署的合約寄給我。

examples.en: A quality audit showed that the supplier follows our standards.
examples.zh: 品質稽核顯示供應商有遵守我們的標準。

examples.en: The manager asked us to audit last year's travel expenses.
examples.zh: 經理要我們查核去年的差旅費用。

confusable.diff: inspection 多指到現場檢查物品、設備或環境；audit 是檢查帳目、文件與制度是否正確。

example.en: The inspection of the new machines will start at nine tomorrow.
example.zh: 新機器的檢查明天九點開始。

confusable.diff: review 是一般的檢視或審閱，比較不正式；audit 是有固定流程的正式稽核。

example.en: Please review the draft contract and send me your comments.
example.zh: 請審閱合約草稿，並把你的意見寄給我。

example.en: The auditor asked to see all the payment records.
example.zh: 稽核員要求查看所有付款紀錄。

example.en: She works in the accounting department of a large bank.
example.zh: 她在一家大銀行的會計部門工作。

example.en: The safety inspection will take place on Tuesday morning.
example.zh: 安全檢查將在星期二早上進行。

example.en: The audit checks our compliance with company policy.
example.zh: 這次稽核會檢查我們是否遵守公司政策。

derived.link: audit + -or，做事的人，像 actor、visitor；負責稽核的人

example.en: The annual audit will begin on the first Monday of March.
example.zh: 年度稽核將在三月第一個星期一開始。

example.en: An outside firm will audit our accounts every year.
example.zh: 一家外部公司每年都會查核我們的帳目。

senses.en: an official check of a company's money records

example.en: The financial audit showed that all the payments were correct.
example.zh: 財務稽核顯示所有付款都正確無誤。

senses.en: a check to see if a company follows its rules or standards
senses.distinguish: 不一定查帳，也可以查流程、品質或安全是否符合標準，前面常加 quality、safety。

example.en: The supplier passed the safety audit with a very high score.
example.zh: 供應商以很高的分數通過了安全稽核。

extra_vocab.zh: 庫存；庫存清單；存貨盤點
extra_vocab.en: all the goods that a company has in stock, or a list of them
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡放在 management software 前面，當作名詞修飾語（inventory management software），指「庫存管理軟體」。多益常見於倉儲、零售與採購情境。

example.en: Good inventory management helps us avoid running out of products.
example.zh: 良好的庫存管理能幫助我們避免商品缺貨。

example.en: The staff will take inventory at the end of the month.
example.zh: 員工會在月底盤點庫存。

example.en: Better inventory control reduced our storage costs this year.
example.zh: 更好的庫存控制降低了我們今年的倉儲成本。

example.en: We have more than 500 units in inventory right now.
example.zh: 我們目前庫存有五百多件。

examples.en: The warehouse manager checks the inventory every Monday morning.
examples.zh: 倉庫經理每週一早上檢查庫存。

examples.en: Our summer inventory will arrive in the stores next week.
examples.zh: 我們的夏季存貨下週會送到各家門市。

examples.en: High inventory levels are costing the company too much money.
examples.zh: 過高的庫存水準讓公司花費太多錢。

confusable.diff: 兩者常可互換；stock 較口語，也可指股票；inventory 較正式，也指「庫存清單」或「盤點」。

example.en: Our stock price rose after the company launched its new product.
example.zh: 公司推出新產品後，我們的股價上漲了。

confusable.diff: supply 是「供應量、補給」；inventory 是公司目前實際持有的貨品。

example.en: The factory has a steady supply of parts from two vendors.
example.zh: 這家工廠有兩家廠商穩定供應零件。

example.en: This item is currently out of stock.
example.zh: 這項商品目前缺貨。

example.en: The goods are kept in a warehouse near the port.
example.zh: 貨物存放在靠近港口的倉庫裡。

derived.link: 同一個詞幹 invent-，是這一組字最基礎的動詞，意思是做出以前沒有的東西
invent + -ion，把「發明」這個動作變成名詞，像 decide → decision
invent + -ive，形容「有發明力的」，像 creative、active

senses.en: all the goods that a company has in stock

example.en: The store keeps a large inventory of winter coats.
example.zh: 這家店備有大量冬季外套的庫存。

senses.en: a list of all the goods or items that a company has
senses.distinguish: 指「一份清單」，常搭配 send、update、check 等動詞。

example.en: Please send me the inventory of office supplies by Friday.
example.zh: 請在週五前把辦公用品的庫存清單寄給我。

senses.en: the act of counting all the goods in a store or warehouse
senses.distinguish: 常見 take inventory 或 inventory count，指清點貨品的動作。

example.en: Inventory will take all day on Saturday, so we close early.
example.zh: 盤點星期六會花一整天，所以我們提早打烊。

extra_vocab.en: regular care and repair of equipment or software that is done or paid for each year
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡 annual maintenance fee 指軟體合約的「年度維護費」，與一次性的初期費用分開，每年一月另外請款。maintenance 是名詞，這裡作為 fee 的修飾詞。

examples.en: The annual maintenance contract covers repairs and software updates.
examples.zh: 年度維護合約涵蓋維修與軟體更新。

examples.en: The elevator needs an annual maintenance check by a licensed company.
examples.zh: 電梯需要由有執照的公司進行年度維護檢查。

examples.en: We have included annual maintenance costs in next year's budget.
examples.zh: 我們已把年度維護費用編入明年的預算。

similar.diff: regular maintenance 是「定期維護」，不限一年一次；annual maintenance 指每年一次。
意思相同；annual 較正式，常用於合約與公文。

confusable.diff: annual 是形容詞（annual fee）；annually 是副詞（paid annually），放在動詞後。

example.en: The annual fee must be paid annually, not monthly.
example.zh: 這筆年費必須按年支付，而不是按月。

extra_vocab.en: sent a bill to someone to ask for payment
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡是被動語態 will be billed，意思是「（這筆費用）將另外開帳單請款」。bill 當動詞時，常見句型是 bill + 人 + for + 費用，或被動 be billed。

example.en: The company will bill us for the extra service.
example.zh: 公司會就額外服務向我們請款。

example.en: Customers are billed monthly for their internet service.
example.zh: 客戶的網路服務按月計費。

example.en: Please contact the billing department about this mistake.
example.zh: 關於這個錯誤，請聯絡帳務部門。

example.en: Please enter your billing address at checkout.
example.zh: 結帳時請輸入您的帳單地址。

examples.en: You were billed twice for the same order last week.
examples.zh: 你上週同一筆訂單被收了兩次費用。

examples.en: The hotel billed my credit card for the wrong amount.
examples.zh: 飯店用我的信用卡扣了錯誤的金額。

confusable.diff: charge 是「收費、扣款」；bill 強調「寄出帳單請對方付款」，不一定馬上扣款。

example.en: The hotel will charge your credit card when you check in.
example.zh: 你辦理入住時，飯店會直接從你的信用卡扣款。

confusable.diff: invoice 作動詞是「開立發票／請款單」，多用於公司之間；bill 較一般，也可對個人。

example.en: Our company will invoice the client after the work is finished.
example.zh: 工作完成後，我們公司會向客戶開立請款單。

example.en: The electricity bill is higher this month.
example.zh: 這個月的電費帳單比較高。

example.en: The billing system will be updated tonight.
example.zh: 帳務系統將於今晚更新。

example.en: We will send the invoice by email.
example.zh: 我們會用電子郵件寄出請款單。

derived.link: bill + -ing，把「開帳單」這件事變成名詞，像 meeting、building
over-（過多）+ bill，開出過多的帳單，像 overtime、overload

example.en: The vendor will bill us at the end of each month.
example.zh: 供應商會在每個月底向我們開帳單。

example.en: Please pay the electricity bill before the due date.
example.zh: 請在到期日之前繳清電費帳單。

senses.en: to send someone a bill to ask for payment

example.en: The clinic will bill your insurance company directly.
example.zh: 診所會直接向你的保險公司請款。

senses.en: to describe something in advertising or news in a certain way
senses.distinguish: 常用被動 be billed as + 名詞，後面沒有金額，也不是請款。

example.en: The conference is billed as the largest in the industry.
example.zh: 這場會議被宣傳為業界規模最大的一場。

senses.en: a piece of paper money
senses.distinguish: 常見於美式英語，前面會有金額，如 a ten-dollar bill。

example.en: The machine only accepts five-dollar and ten-dollar bills.
example.zh: 這台機器只收五美元和十美元的紙鈔。

senses.en: a plan for a new law that is discussed by lawmakers
senses.distinguish: 常搭配 pass、sign、a bill，出現在新聞或政府相關情境。

example.en: The new bill would lower taxes for small businesses.
example.zh: 這項新法案會降低小型企業的稅負。

extra_vocab.en: especially; used to point to one important thing in a larger group
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡放在句首，用來從「請仔細檢閱合約」這個大範圍中，點出最需要注意的一項（提前終止條款）。語感是「其中特別要留意的是…」，後面常接逗號。
extra_vocab.pattern: In particular, + 句子 ／ 名詞 + in particular

examples.en: Sales improved last quarter, in particular in the online market.
examples.zh: 上一季銷售成長，尤其是在網路市場。

examples.en: Please read the safety rules. In particular, note the new exit plan.
examples.zh: 請閱讀安全規定，特別要留意新的逃生路線。

examples.en: Customers liked the service, and the fast delivery in particular.
examples.zh: 顧客喜歡這項服務，尤其喜歡快速送貨。

similar.diff: especially 是副詞，可放在句中修飾；in particular 常放句首或句尾，語氣較正式、較強調。
specifically 強調「明確指出某一項」；in particular 強調「特別重要的一項」。

confusable.diff: particularly 是副詞，放在形容詞或動詞前（particularly useful）；in particular 是片語，通常獨立使用。

example.en: The new software is particularly useful for small warehouses.
example.zh: 這套新軟體對小型倉庫特別有用。

extra_vocab.en: the act of ending something, such as a contract or a job
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡是合約用語，early termination 指「提前終止合約」，也就是未滿期限就取消服務，因此會有額外費用。多益合約與人事情境中常見，語氣正式。

example.en: Either side may request termination of the contract in writing.
example.zh: 任何一方都可以書面要求終止合約。

example.en: We must send a termination notice thirty days in advance.
example.zh: 我們必須提前三十天寄出終止通知。

example.en: A termination fee applies if you cancel in the first year.
example.zh: 若您在第一年內取消，需支付解約費。

example.en: The termination of employment will take effect on March 1.
example.zh: 終止僱用將於三月一日生效。

examples.en: Early termination may cause extra costs for both companies.
examples.zh: 提前終止可能讓兩家公司都產生額外費用。

examples.en: The employee received a letter about the termination of his job.
examples.zh: 那位員工收到一封關於終止他工作的信。

examples.en: The company decided to terminate the agreement with the supplier.
examples.zh: 公司決定終止與供應商的協議。

confusable.diff: cancellation 是取消訂單、預約或服務；termination 多指終止合約或僱用關係，較正式。

example.en: Please confirm the cancellation of the hotel booking by e-mail.
example.zh: 請用電子郵件確認取消飯店訂房。

confusable.diff: expiration 是「到期」，時間到了自然結束；termination 是主動提前結束，或依條款終止。

example.en: The expiration date of the contract is printed on page one.
example.zh: 合約的到期日印在第一頁。

example.en: You may terminate the service at any time.
example.zh: 您可以隨時終止這項服務。

example.en: Please cancel my order before it ships.
example.zh: 請在出貨前取消我的訂單。

example.en: Our contract will expire at the end of June.
example.zh: 我們的合約將在六月底到期。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹；terminate + -ion 變成名詞「終止」，像 educate → education、locate → location
termin（終點）+ -al，指路線的終點，像 airport terminal（機場航廈）

senses.en: the act of ending a contract or an agreement

example.en: The termination date in the contract is December thirty-first.
example.zh: 合約中的終止日期是十二月三十一日。

senses.en: the act of ending someone's job
senses.distinguish: 主語或對象是員工或工作時，指解僱；常見 termination letter。

example.en: The company explained the reason for her termination in a letter.
example.zh: 公司在信中說明了她被解僱的原因。

extra_vocab.en: one part of a contract or law that gives a rule or condition
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇指合約裡的一條「條款」。the clause concerning early termination 就是專門談提前終止合約的那一條，簽約前要特別看清楚。

example.en: The termination clause requires thirty days' written notice.
example.zh: 終止條款要求提前三十天以書面通知。

example.en: Our lawyer asked us to add a clause about late fees.
example.zh: 我們的律師要求我們加入一項關於逾期費用的條款。

example.en: The contract includes a clause that protects customer data.
example.zh: 這份合約包含一項保護客戶資料的條款。

examples.en: The last clause says either side can end the contract.
examples.zh: 最後一條條款說明任何一方都可以終止合約。

examples.en: Please see the clause on page three for payment rules.
examples.zh: 付款規定請參閱第三頁的條款。

examples.en: A clause has a subject and a verb.
examples.zh: 子句包含一個主詞和一個動詞。

confusable.diff: term 常指合約中的「條件、條款內容」（terms and conditions），可複數泛指；clause 是合約中一條一條的「條文」。

example.en: Please read the terms of the contract before you sign it.
example.zh: 簽約前請先閱讀合約的條款內容。

confusable.diff: 文法上 phrase 是沒有「主詞＋動詞」的詞組；clause 則有主詞和動詞。

example.en: The words "on time" are a phrase, because they have no verb.
example.zh: 「on time」這幾個字是片語，因為裡面沒有動詞。

example.en: This provision applies to all new employees.
example.zh: 這項規定適用於所有新進員工。

example.en: Please read the terms before you sign.
example.zh: 簽名前請先閱讀條款。

example.en: One condition of the offer is a signed contract.
example.zh: 這項提案的條件之一是簽妥合約。

example.en: Both companies signed the agreement last week.
example.zh: 兩家公司上週簽署了這份協議。

senses.en: one part of a contract that gives a rule or condition

example.en: The payment clause says all invoices are due in thirty days.
example.zh: 付款條款規定所有請款單須在三十天內付清。

senses.en: a group of words with a subject and a verb
senses.distinguish: 在英文文法或寫作的情境出現，如 main clause（主要子句）。

example.en: In this sentence, the clause after "because" gives the reason.
example.zh: 在這個句子裡，because 後面的子句說明了原因。

extra_vocab.zh: 餘額、尾款；平衡（動詞：使平衡）
extra_vocab.en: the money that is still left to pay or still in an account
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇指付款後「剩下的尾款」。the remaining balance 就是頭期款 40% 付完後，剩下要在安裝後三十天內付清的金額。

example.en: The remaining balance is due at the end of the month.
example.zh: 剩餘款項須在月底前付清。

example.en: Please pay the balance before the machine is shipped.
example.zh: 請在機器出貨前付清尾款。

example.en: Check your account balance before you place the order.
example.zh: 下訂單前請先確認你的帳戶餘額。

example.en: The balance due on this invoice is two thousand dollars.
example.zh: 這張發票的應付餘額是兩千美元。

examples.en: We will send you a bill for the balance next week.
examples.zh: 我們下週會寄給你尾款的帳單。

examples.en: Your balance is shown at the top of the statement.
examples.zh: 你的餘額顯示在對帳單的最上方。

examples.en: We must balance cost and quality in this project.
examples.zh: 我們在這個專案中必須兼顧成本與品質。

confusable.diff: remainder 泛指「剩下的部分」（時間、物品都可以）；balance 在財務上特指「帳戶餘額或尚未付清的金額」。

example.en: We will use the remainder of the budget for staff training.
example.zh: 我們會把預算剩下的部分用在員工訓練上。

example.en: We paid a deposit to reserve the meeting room.
example.zh: 我們付了訂金來預訂會議室。

example.en: The first payment is due when the contract is signed.
example.zh: 第一筆款項在簽約時到期。

example.en: You can pay the fee in three installments.
example.zh: 你可以分三期付這筆費用。

example.en: The invoice shows the total amount and the due date.
example.zh: 請款單上列有總金額和到期日。

derived.link: un-（不）+ balanced，不平衡的，像 unhappy、unable 的 un-
im-（不）+ balance，變成「不平衡」的名詞，像 impossible 的 im-

example.en: Please check the balance before you transfer the money.
example.zh: 轉帳之前，請先確認餘額。

example.en: The accountant balances the books at the end of each month.
example.zh: 會計人員每個月底都會結清帳目。

senses.en: the money that is still left to pay or still in an account

example.en: The balance on your account is shown on the screen.
example.zh: 你的帳戶餘額顯示在螢幕上。

senses.en: a good mix of two or more things
senses.distinguish: 和金額無關，常見 work-life balance，意思是工作與生活的平衡。

example.en: She tries to keep a good balance between work and family.
example.zh: 她努力在工作和家庭之間保持良好的平衡。

senses.en: to give the right amount of attention to two or more things
senses.distinguish: 後面常接兩件事，如 balance A and B；和結算帳目的用法不同。

example.en: The new schedule balances the needs of staff and customers.
example.zh: 新的班表兼顧了員工與顧客的需求。

extra_vocab.zh: 合約、契約（動詞 /kənˈtrækt/：簽約承包；收縮）
extra_vocab.en: a written agreement between people or companies that the law can enforce
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇是名詞，作主旨的標題字：Updated Software Contract 是「更新後的軟體合約」。後面 Under the contract 與 signed contract 都是同一個字。

example.en: All managers must sign a contract before work begins.
example.zh: 所有經理必須在開工前簽署合約。

example.en: We plan to renew the contract next spring.
example.zh: 我們打算明年春天續約。

example.en: Either side may terminate the contract with written notice.
example.zh: 任何一方都可以書面通知終止合約。

example.en: Under the contract, the supplier must deliver on time.
example.zh: 依據合約，供應商必須準時交貨。

examples.en: Please send the signed contract back to me today.
examples.zh: 請今天把簽好的合約寄回給我。

examples.en: The supplier offered us a one-year contract.
examples.zh: 供應商向我們提出一年期的合約。

examples.en: Her contract ends in March, so she must decide soon.
examples.zh: 她的合約三月到期，所以她得盡快決定。

examples.en: The company contracts with a local firm for cleaning.
examples.zh: 這家公司與一家當地公司簽約負責清潔。

confusable.diff: 拼法很像：contact /ˈkɑːntækt/ 是「聯絡、接觸」；contract 是「合約」，中間多一個 r。

example.en: Please contact the supplier if you have questions about the delivery.
example.zh: 如果對交貨有疑問，請聯絡供應商。

confusable.diff: agreement 是較廣的「協議」，不一定有法律效力；contract 是正式、有法律約束力的合約。

example.en: The two managers reached a verbal agreement, but nothing is signed yet.
example.zh: 兩位經理口頭上達成了協議，但還沒有簽任何文件。

example.en: We reached an agreement on the delivery date.
example.zh: 我們在交貨日期上達成了協議。

example.en: The two firms made a deal on prices.
example.zh: 兩家公司就價格達成了交易。

example.en: The terms of the contract are clear.
example.zh: 合約的條款很清楚。

example.en: We sent a proposal to the client on Monday.
example.zh: 我們週一把提案寄給了客戶。

derived.link: contract + -or，做事的人，像 actor、visitor；簽約承包工作的人或公司
contract + -ual，變成形容詞，字尾像 annual（文章裡也出現過）

example.en: The contract must be signed by both sides before March.
example.zh: 這份合約必須在三月之前由雙方簽署。

example.en: The city contracted a local firm to repair the road.
example.zh: 市政府委託一家當地公司修補道路。

extra_vocab.zh: 預算（動詞：編列預算；形容詞：低價的）
extra_vocab.en: the amount of money a person or company plans to spend
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇指公司為新軟體編列的「預算」。approved the budget 表示財務部已核准這筆預算，後面的合約付款才能進行。

example.en: The board will approve the budget on Friday.
example.zh: 董事會將在週五核准預算。

example.en: The project went over budget by ten percent.
example.zh: 這個專案超出預算百分之十。

example.en: Please keep the event within budget.
example.zh: 請讓活動維持在預算範圍內。

example.en: The budget cut forced us to delay hiring.
example.zh: 預算刪減迫使我們延後招聘。

examples.en: The budget for next year will be discussed on Monday.
examples.zh: 明年的預算將在週一討論。

examples.en: Please send your budget request to finance by Friday.
examples.zh: 請在週五前把你的預算申請寄給財務部。

examples.en: We booked a budget hotel near the airport.
examples.zh: 我們訂了機場附近一間平價旅館。

examples.en: We need to budget carefully for travel this year.
examples.zh: 我們今年必須謹慎編列差旅預算。

confusable.diff: budget 是「預計可以花的額度」；cost 是「實際花掉的費用」。

example.en: The total cost of the repairs was higher than we expected.
example.zh: 維修的總費用比我們預期的高。

example.en: The cost of the new system is very high.
example.zh: 新系統的成本非常高。

example.en: Travel expenses must be reported every month.
example.zh: 差旅費用必須每個月申報。

example.en: We need more funds to finish the project.
example.zh: 我們需要更多資金來完成這個專案。

example.en: The sales forecast helps us plan the budget.
example.zh: 銷售預測幫助我們規劃預算。

example.en: The marketing budget for next quarter was approved yesterday.
example.zh: 下一季的行銷預算昨天已獲核准。

example.en: Each department must budget for training costs this year.
example.zh: 每個部門今年都必須為訓練費用編列預算。

example.en: The airline offers budget fares on many short routes.
example.zh: 這家航空公司在許多短程航線提供平價機票。

senses.en: the amount of money a person or company plans to spend

example.en: Our travel budget is much smaller than last year's.
example.zh: 我們的差旅預算比去年少很多。

senses.en: a written plan that shows how money will be spent
senses.distinguish: 指一份文件或計畫，常搭配 prepare、submit、attach。

example.en: Please attach a detailed budget to your project proposal.
example.zh: 請在專案提案中附上詳細的預算表。

extra_vocab.en: needing to be paid or done at a certain time
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡是形容詞，放在 are 後面當補語：all invoices are due in thirty days，意思是「請款單必須在三十天這個期限內付清」。合約與請款情境很常見，後面常接 on／by + 日期或 in + 一段時間。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: be due to + 原形動詞表示「預定要…」；due to + 名詞則是「由於…」，兩者意思不同，不要搞混。

example.en: Please write the due date clearly on every invoice.
example.zh: 請把到期日清楚寫在每一張請款單上。

example.en: Your account is past due, so please pay today.
example.zh: 您的帳戶已逾期，請於今天付款。

example.en: Production stopped for two hours due to a lack of parts.
example.zh: 由於缺少零件，生產停了兩個小時。

example.en: The new manager is due to join us on Monday.
example.zh: 新經理預定週一加入我們。

examples.en: Our office rent is due on the first day of every month.
examples.zh: 我們的辦公室租金每個月一號到期。

examples.en: The final report is due next Friday, so please start early.
examples.zh: 最終報告下週五要交，所以請提早開始。

examples.en: The meeting was moved to Tuesday due to heavy rain.
examples.zh: 由於大雨，會議改到了星期二。

confusable.diff: expire 是「有效期限結束」，如合約、優惠券；due 是「該付款或完成的時間點」。

example.en: The coupon will expire at the end of this month.
example.zh: 這張優惠券會在本月底失效。

confusable.diff: owe 是動詞「欠（款）」；due 是形容詞，描述款項到期了或該付了。
confusable.usage: owe 是動詞，句型是 owe + 人 + 錢（We owe the supplier $500）；due 是形容詞，要搭配 be 動詞（The payment is due）。

example.en: We owe the supplier ten thousand dollars for the parts.
example.zh: 我們欠供應商一萬美元的零件款。

example.en: Please send the invoice to the accounting team.
example.zh: 請把請款單寄給會計團隊。

example.en: We must meet the deadline for the tax report.
example.zh: 我們必須趕上稅務報告的截止日期。

example.en: We received your payment this morning, thank you.
example.zh: 我們今天早上收到了您的款項，謝謝。

example.en: The company still owes us for the last order.
example.zh: 公司還欠我們上一筆訂單的款項。

derived.link: over-（超過）+ due，超過了到期日，像 overtime、overload 的 over-

example.en: The balance is due within fourteen days of delivery.
example.zh: 餘額須在交貨後十四天內付清。

pos_uses.zh: （常用複數 dues）會費、應繳款項

example.en: Members must pay their annual dues by the end of March.
example.zh: 會員必須在三月底前繳交年費。

senses.en: needing to be paid or done at a certain time

example.en: All payments are due within fourteen days of the invoice date.
example.zh: 所有款項須在請款單日期後十四天內付清。

senses.en: expected to happen or arrive at a certain time
senses.distinguish: 常用 be due to + V 或 be due + 時間，指「預計會發生或抵達」，不是付款。

example.en: The delivery truck is due to arrive at noon.
example.zh: 送貨卡車預計中午抵達。
